litigation.mdlName: In re: Johnson & Johnson Talcum Powder Products Marketing, Sales Practices and Products Liability Litigation
litigation.court: U.S. District Court, District of New Jersey

phase: Conditional ovarian-cancer settlement proposal; MDL remains active
phaseDetail: On July 27, 2026, Johnson & Johnson disclosed a proposed $5.5 billion ovarian-talc resolution conditional on at least 95% participation and other criteria. Its disclosed funding schedule begins in 2027. This is a conditional proposal, not confirmation that all claims are resolved or that individual payments are available. J&J disputes the allegations.

pendingCounts.scope: Pending actions in MDL-2738 (largest active MDL by actions pending)
pendingCounts.source: JPML, Pending MDL Dockets by Actions Pending, June 1, 2026

defendants: Kenvue Inc. (consumer-health spinoff; Johnson's Baby Powder brand)
LLT Management LLC (formerly LTL Management) / Red River Talc LLC (J&J talc-liability subsidiaries)

settlements.label: Proposed ovarian-talc resolution
settlements.detail: J&J’s July 27, 2026 SEC-filed announcement requires participation representing at least 95% of remaining ovarian-talc claims and other conditions. It calls for an initial payment of no more than $3 billion in 2027, with no additional payments due before 2028. This describes company funding, not an individual claimant payment date. The records reviewed on September 14 do not establish satisfaction of all conditions.
settlements.individualClaims: No universal per-person payment or claimant deadline verified. The proposal concerns ovarian-talc litigation; do not treat it as a new mesothelioma claim program.
settlements.source: J&J announcement filed with the SEC, July 27, 2026

keyDates.label: MDL-2738 established
keyDates.detail: JPML originally assigned the litigation to Judge Freda L. Wolfson; Judge Michael A. Shipp now presides.

keyDates.label: Red River bankruptcy dismissed
keyDates.detail: The January 2026 special master report records denial of plan confirmation and dismissal of the bankruptcy.

keyDates.label: Expert report and recommendation filed
keyDates.detail: Special Master Freda L. Wolfson addressed Rule 702 expert-admissibility motions; the report is not a trial verdict.

keyDates.label: Conditional ovarian-talc proposal announced
keyDates.detail: J&J disclosed its $5.5 billion commitment and participation conditions.

keyDates.label: 69,250 actions pending
keyDates.detail: JPML still lists the MDL as active; historical total 71,935.

updates.summary: JPML reports 69,250 pending actions and 71,935 historical actions in MDL-2738.
Pending actions increased by 336 from 68,914 on August 3, 2026. This is a net docket change, not a count of new claims.
J&J disclosed a conditional $5.5 billion ovarian-talc proposal requiring at least 95% participation.
The disclosed company funding begins with no more than $3 billion in 2027; it is not a claimant payment date.
A special master filed recommendations on Rule 702 expert-admissibility motions, distinct from any jury verdict.
